# Commit ID map

The history of `main` was rewritten on 2026-10-27 (the user's decision) to drop the AI co-author trailer
("Co-Authored-By: Claude ...") from every commit message. Nothing else changed: each commit keeps its tree, parents,
author, committer and dates (checked commit by commit), and the commit IDs cited inside four messages were updated.

Commit IDs quoted in files committed before the rewrite (docs, `feature_list.json`, `progress.md`, result files,
`results/submissions.csv`, build stamps) refer to the old history and map to the new one below, oldest first. The
earlier rewrite of 2026-10-19 has its own table in `docs/DATA_POLICY.md`; its "new" IDs are the "old" IDs here.
